metaDescription: Brand custom golf carabiners with your logo. Ideal for tournaments and corporate gifts. Order bulk from Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Golf carabiners combine the practicality of a keychain clip with a design that resonates on the course. Whether you need a divot repair tool integrated into the carabiner or a sleek metal finish that matches a pro shop aesthetic, these accessories keep your brand visible from the first tee to the 19th hole. Perfect for tournament swag bags or corporate outing favors, custom golf carabiners offer a functional giveaway that golfers actually use.
heroAltText: Custom golf carabiners with a divot repair tool and key ring, ideal for tournament giveaways
